descriptions.g4b_build_commands_801a9478: Builds an external command word stream from16-byte ranges of item pointers. Sizes storage from three words per item, emits changed group/index/mode table values followed by each item value, adjusts storage to emitted length, clears owner dirty at284 and returns command object at176. Reuses kind1/count-matched array storage through lock-count increments or calls801ef048. All receiver/header/range views are external and never locally constructed; table extents remain opaque.
